newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's turnover rises to $148 mln/H1.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's turnover rises to $148 mln/H1.

text.p: Morocco's Banque Commerciale du Maroc, the country's second largest bank, published its audited balance sheet showing a rise of 5.8 percent in its turnover to 1.289 billion dirhams ($148.1 million) in the first half of 1996 from the same period last year.
BCM's turnover was 1.218 billion dirhams in the first half of 1995, stockbrokers said on Wednesday.
Morocco's largest private conglomerate ONA Group, has 20 percent of BCM stock through its portfolio management firm Financiere Diwan.
The bank posted profit of 271.7 million dirhams in the first half of the year but gave no comparison with the same period in 1995.
Established in 1911 in Casablanca, BCM has a capital of 1.32 billion dirhams. The bank has a market capitalisation of 8.7 billion dirhams, the largest in the Casablanca stock market.
BCM shares were traded at 676 dirhams per share on Wednesday, up six dirhams on the previous session.
